productConcept.name: Filum
productConcept.description: Filum is an archival digitization studio based in Amsterdam, specialising in drum scanning of large-format film, Flextight medium-format and 35mm scanning, cine film digitization, and institutional archive projects. Intake by appointment. Emphasises the materiality of the photographic object — the scan as a faithful translation of light embedded in silver and dye.
